landing.headline: Give every euro a job.
landing.lead: BudgetPlaner is the family budget for people who plan ahead instead of tracking afterwards: income, expenses, debts, cash flow and savings – together, clearly laid out, even offline.
landing.previewLabel: Sample view of the monthly hub
landing.areasLead: Five areas for everyday life – plus statistics, forecasts and shared planning.
landing.ruleText: Half for needs, 30% for wants, 20% for saving and paying off debt. BudgetPlaner shows you where you stand every month.
landing.privacy.1: No bank connection – you decide what to enter.
landing.privacy.2: Amounts and names are stored encrypted.
landing.privacy.3: Export as Excel, CSV or JSON at any time.
landing.privacy.4: Account and data can be deleted completely at any time.
landing.ctaText: Your first month is planned in five minutes.
